SubLayerProcessing.SQLScript: SELECT alertGroupID AS alertGroupKey, alertGroupCode, alertGroupDescription, displayText, sortOrder, isActive FROM alertGroup
SubLayerProcessing.MergeScript: MERGE INTO claimspan.gold.gold_dimalertgroup t USING (SELECT * FROM tempSQLScript) s ON s.alertGroupKey = t.alertGroupKey WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.alertGroupCode = s.alertGroupCode, t.alertGroupDescription = s.alertGroupDescription, t.displayText = s.displayText, t.sortOrder = s.sortOrder, t.isActive = s.isActive WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (alertGroupKey, alertGroupCode, alertGroupDescription, displayText, sortOrder, isActive) VALUES (s.alertGroupKey, s.alertGroupCode, s.alertGroupDescription, s.displayText, s.sortOrder, s.isActive)
